title: Bad Company #1 2 3 4 Lot Quality Comics 1988 Milligan Ewins McCarthy 2000 AD
conditionDescription: All four covers bright and glossy with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Bad Company #1, #2, #3 and #4 (1988), Quality Comics - the US reprint of the 2000 AD war/horror strip by Peter Milligan, Brett Ewins and Jim McCarthy. Original $1.50 cover price each.

You get all 4 issues:
- #1 - Halo Jones featuring Bad Company, Bad Company line-up cover; back cover: Brett Ewins Bad Company "Coming Soon" pin-up
- #2 - Sears/Pennington cover; back cover: Quality Comics line-up ad
- #3 - Sears/Pennington cover; back cover: Quality Comics line-up ad
- #4 - Sears/Pennington cover; back cover: Quality Comics line-up ad

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
